name: taxation
description: Finnish taxation for professionals: tax procedure and appeals (VML 1558/1995), corporate taxation (EVL 360/1968) including reorganisations, and value added tax (AVL 1501/1993). Tax rates and euro amounts always from the source — never from memory.

Verokannat ja euromäärät aina lähteestä; tulkinnanvaraisissa ennakkoratkaisu.
